# Travelers Universe

> > Travelers Universe offers curated Caribbean tours, excursions, and private transfers across Jamaica, Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, and other island destinations.

The platform specializes in authentic Caribbean experiences including bamboo rafting in Jamaica, cultural tours in Montego Bay and San Juan, private yacht charters, fishing expeditions, and seamless airport and hotel transfers throughout the Caribbean islands.

## Key Topics

- Jamaica tours and excursions
- Montego Bay attractions
- Caribbean adventure activities
- Bamboo rafting experiences
- Private transfers and airport shuttles
- San Juan and Puerto Rico tours
- Punta Cana adventures
- Luxury yacht and catamaran cruises
- Caribbean fishing charters
- Negril and Ricks Cafe
- Cultural experiences
- Beach and snorkeling tours
- Bob Marley heritage sites
- Dominican Republic excursions
- Virgin Islands tours

## Jamaica Adventures & Cultural Tours

- [Yacht Picnic in Jamaica](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/yacht-picnic-in-jamaica): Luxury yacht tour in Montego Bay with tropical bites and cocktails
- [New Ocean Bamboo Rafting, HorsebackRiding & Sunset At Ricks Cafe](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/new-ocean-bamboo-rafting-horsebackriding-sunset-at-ricks-cafe): Full-day Jamaica adventure: bamboo rafting, horseback riding & Ricks Cafe
- [Montego Bay Highlights Tour with Shopping and Bamboo Rafting](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/montego-bay-highlights-tour-with-shopping-and-bamboo-rafting): Montego Bay cultural tour with Harbor Street Market & Great River rafting
- [Portland Rio Grande Rafting & Boston Jerk Day Tour](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/portland-rio-grande-rafting-boston-jerk-day-tour): 7-hour Portland tour: Rio Grande bamboo rafting & Boston Jerk Centre
- [Private Bob Marley Nine Miles Tour](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/private-bob-marley-nine-miles-tour): 5-hour private tour to Bob Marley's birthplace & mausoleum in Nine Miles

## Caribbean Island Excursions

- [Isla Saona Private Catamaran Cruise (All Inclusive)](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/isla-saona-private-catamaran-cruise-all-inclusive): All-inclusive private catamaran to Isla Saona from Bayahibe with buffet
- [Swimming with the pigs, turtles and reef snorkeling!!!](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/swimming-with-the-pigs-turtles-and-reef-snorkeling): 4-hour Nassau tour: swimming pigs, turtles & reef snorkeling at Green Cay
- [Western snorkel & swim Trip](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/western-snorkel-swim-trip): Full-day Curacao snorkel tour: Shete Boka, Kleine Knip & sea turtles
- [Prince Taxi and Island tours in St.thomas US Virgin Island](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/prince-taxi-and-island-tours-in-st-thomas-us-virgin-island): Private 5-hour St. Thomas tour with Drake's Seat & Magens Bay
- [St. Croix Rainforest Ecohike and Beach](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/st-croix-rainforest-ecohike-and-beach): Guided St. Croix rainforest hike with historic sites & Caribbean beach

## Puerto Rico & Dominican Republic Tours

- [Puerto Rican Salsa Class and Night Out in San Juan, Puerto Rico](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/puerto-rican-salsa-class-and-night-out-in-san-juan-puerto-rico): Salsa dance class & nightlife experience in San Juan with Jan Carlos
- [Full Day Private Shore Tour in San Juan from Ponce Cruise Port](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/full-day-private-shore-tour-in-san-juan-from-ponce-cruise-port): Customizable private shore excursion from Ponce Port to San Juan
- [Santo Domingo: 3 Eyes Park & Botanical Garden Tour](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/santo-domingo-3-eyes-park-botanical-garden-tour): 5-hour guided tour of Three Eyes Park caves and National Botanical Garden
- [Buggy Adventure in Punta Cana: Macao Beach and Taino Cave](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/buggy-adventure-in-punta-cana-macao-beach-and-taino-cave): Off-road buggy tour to Macao Beach, Taino Cave & Dominican village

## Caribbean Fishing Charters

- [Punta Cana: Private Trolling Fishing Trip with Pickup](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/punta-cana-private-trolling-fishing-trip-with-pickup): 4-hour private trolling fishing in Punta Cana with catch-and-cook option
- [Saint Kitts & Nevis: Private Fishing Charter with Open Bar](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/saint-kitts-nevis-private-fishing-charter-with-open-bar): Private fishing charter in Caribbean Sea with open bar & snorkeling

## Private Transfers & Airport Shuttles

- [San Juan Port to San Juan Airport (SJU) - Departure Private Transfer](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/san-juan-port-to-san-juan-airport-sju-departure-private-transfer): Private transfer from San Juan Port to Luis Munoz Marin Airport
- [Montego Bay Airport to Grand Bahia Principe](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/montego-bay-airport-to-grand-bahia-principe): Private transfer from Sangster Airport to Grand Bahia Principe resort
- [Airport Transfer to Runaway Bay Hotels (Round-Trip)](https://www.travelersuniverse.com/airport-transfer-to-runaway-bay-hotels-round-trip): Round-trip private transfer to Runaway Bay hotels from Jamaica airport
